about: Park Overlap Finder regions (chat 3, Oct 27). Each region = its own list on kpc-overlap-finder.html. files = data/fers/<file>.json in KPC-Data (base below); missing = the region's Missing-boundary file (members only). public:false = members only until Brandon's GO for that region. Add a region (e.g. Southeast) when chat 2 says its data is final. showWaiting:true = members see the results still waiting for review without ticking the box (tagged WAITING FOR REVIEW); Brandon Oct 27 2:15 PM for testing Kentucky. note = a banner over that region's list (e.g. while a rerun is pending); remove it when the region's data is final.
